{{Short description|Brazilian mathematics competition}}
{{Orphan|date=December 2021}}

The '''Olimpíada de Matemática do Grande ABC''' (English:''Grande ABC Mathematical Olympiad''), or '''OMABC''' is a mathematical competition for pre-[[college|collegiate]] Brazilian students of [[Grande ABC]] region, composed by the following cities:<ref name="Apresentação da Olimpíada">{{cite web |url=https://portal.metodista.br/omabc/2015/apresentacao/apresentacao | title=Apresentação da OMABC - Universidade Metodista de São Paulo |publisher=[[Universidade Metodista de São Paulo]] |access-date=5 December 2015}}</ref><ref>[http://www.obm.org.br/opencms/competicoes/regionais/ COMPETIÇÕES REGIONAIS] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180110123456/http://www.obm.org.br/opencms/competicoes/regionais/ |date=2018-01-10 }}, acesso em 09 de junho de 2014</ref><ref>[http://portal.metodista.br/ev/omabc/ Metodista: Eventos], acesso em 05 de dezembro de 2015</ref>

* [[File:BandeiraSantoAndre.svg|border|20px]] [[Santo André (São Paulo)|Santo André]]
* [[File:Bandeira de São Caetano do Sul.svg|border|20px]] [[São Caetano do Sul]] 
* [[File:Bandeira_de_S%C3%A3o_Bernardo_do_Campo.jpg|border|20px]] [[São Bernardo do Campo]]
* [[File:Bandeira_de_Diadema-SP,_Brasil.png|border|20px]] [[Diadema, São Paulo|Diadema]]
* [[File:Bandeira_Maua_SaoPaulo_Brasil.svg|border|20px]] [[Mauá]]
* [[File:Bandeira-ribeiraopires.jpg|border|20px]] [[Ribeirão Pires]]
* [[File:Bandeira-riograndedaserra.png|border|20px]] [[Rio Grande da Serra]]

The Faculdade de Ciências Exatas e Tecnológicas da [[Universidade Metodista de São Paulo]] is the main organizer of this event, who create the tests and correct then. The main purpose of this olympiad is improve the mathematical knowledge, encouraging the study and research in [[science|scientific areas]].,<ref>{{cite web | last1=Br | first1=Noticias. Universia. com |url=http://noticias.universia.com.br/tempo-livre/noticia/2005/07/22/469878/alunos-do-abc-podem-participar-da-2-olimpiada-matematica-da-regio.html | title=Alunos do ABC podem participar da 2¦ Olimpíada de Matemática da região | work=Noticias Universia Brasil |publisher=Site Universia |access-date=5 December 2015}}</ref> and contributing to participate in national mathematical competitions, like [[Olimpíada Brasileira de Matemática das Escolas Públicas]] and [[Olimpíada Brasileira de Matemática]]. The first edition was held in 2004.

== Awards ==

=== Students ===

The participants are ranked based on their individual scores. Medals are awarded to the highest ranked participants, such that slightly less than half of them receive a medal. Subsequently, the cutoffs (minimum scores required to receive a gold, silver or bronze medal respectively) are chosen such that the ratio of gold to silver to bronze medals awarded approximates 1 : 2 : 3.<ref name="Colégio Nóbilis">{{cite web |url=http://www.colegionobilis.com.br/omabc-agatha/ |title=Agatha Von Randow, medalhista na XII OMABC |publisher=Colégio Nobilis |access-date=5 December 2015 |archive-date=8 December 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151208153051/http://www.colegionobilis.com.br/omabc-agatha/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>

* [[File:Gold medal.svg|20px]] '''[[Gold medal]]'''
* [[File:Silver medal.svg|20px]] '''[[Silver medal]]'''
* [[File:Bronze medal.svg|20px]] '''[[Bronze medal]]'''

=== Schools ===

Special prizes are awarded for the schools:<ref name="Prêmios">{{cite web |url=https://portal.metodista.br/omabc/2015/premios |title=Prêmios da OMABC - Universidade Metodista de São Paulo |publisher=[[Universidade Metodista de São Paulo]] |access-date=5 December 2015 }}{{Dead link|date=January 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

* [[File:Trophy.jpg|30px]] '''[[Trophy]]''': For the schools whose students received at least a  golden medal.
*  '''[[Honorable Mention]]''': For the schools at least one student received an award.
